clips.title: The story
paras: At the Barrens and Stonetalon border, Seereth Stonebreak sends the Horde to strike Venture Company loggers in Windshear Crag. Their work lays waste to the mountains' ancient woodlands.

The Venture Company has cut deep into the Stonetalon Mountains, tearing through crags and valleys. Its loggers strip hillsides of timber and burn the underbrush, leaving scorched ground behind. For tauren and their allies, this is more than the destruction of forests by a mining and lumber company. The primal spirits bound to Stonetalon howl in torment. Seereth Stonebreak, stationed along the mountain border, sees that the goblins' relentless assault has left the spirits blind with agony and fury.

The Venture Company's executives and hirelings care only for profit, and reason will not sway them. Seereth sends travelers past Greatwood Vale and into Windshear Crag to kill fifteen loggers. The Horde means to meet the company's greed with force, halting the deforestation and buying time for tauren elders to soothe the land's agitated spirits.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The goblin-run Venture Company moved into the Stonetalon Mountains, chopping down trees and burning huge stretches of forest. The spirits of this place are nearly blind with pain and rage. We must stop the Venture Company!

Head northwest, beyond the Greatwood Vale and into the Windshear Crag. You will find the goblins and their servants at work -- show them the Horde will not allow the exploitation of Stonetalon. Show them in the language they best understand...

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Greatwood Vale lies to the northwest, friend. Go. Strike fear into those who would pillage this land!

clips.title: Completion
paras: We may ultimately need the wisdom of tauren elders to calm the spirits of Stonetalon, but...
Ridding the Venture Company of its personnel is a good first move against them.
